task_prompt:
Generate the RGB video requested in `prompt.txt`, following `GENERATION_RULES.md` and `task_spec.json`. There is no input image. Choose your own approach. Visual image tools are disabled.

Aim for high-quality output while considering efficiency.
rules:
# PixelWorld generation contract v2

- Use only `prompt.txt` and `task_spec.json`. Work inside this workspace. No network, other cases, reference continuations, masks, scores, memory, external AI models, learned weights, external simulation/rendering engines, or subagents.
- Generate 20 RGB frames at 256×144, 4 fps, for 5 seconds. Generate all frames from the text.
- You must create `generate.py`, run it, and call `artifact_io.save(frames, case_dir)` at least once before finishing. Finish only after the required output artifacts exist. Keep `generate.py` runnable so it regenerates the submitted RGB video.
- Local Python/numpy/PIL, mathematical geometry, motion, lighting, copying and warping pixels are allowed.
- Construct the video directly in image/pixel space. Do not build a separate scene/world model or physics simulation and render it into video.
- Aim for live-action photographic realism for the full scene, with coherent appearance and motion.
- If you revise the video, save each revised candidate before continuing. Avoid repeated revision without a clear expected improvement; aim for high-quality output while considering efficiency.
